The problem

A shipment is split across invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and customs documents that have to line up.

Documents: Invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and customs documents.

Example checks

Check 1

Match invoice totals to packing lists.

Check 2

Check quantities against the bill of lading.

Check 3

Compare invoice and customs figures for review.

How it works

01

Prepare the data

enterlabs reads invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and customs documents and turns them into structured data.

02

Check against agreed rules

It lines up totals, quantities and weights across the set of documents for each shipment.

03

Review and record

A person reviews each flagged item and makes the final call. Every review is recorded.

An example screen

An invoice, a packing list and a bill of lading side by side. One quantity difference is flagged for review.
